opening.argument: The title promises a free Saint Quartz hack for Fate/Grand Order, and the video directs viewers to an external generator where they enter a username, choose an amount, and complete human verification. The hack-console display reinforces that claimed route to rewards. The description then asks viewers who have not received their Saint Quartz to provide a data transfer number and password to receive gems. That combination of promised free resources, verification, and account-related requests supports the scam concern. The fair-use disclaimer and credit to the original hack owner provide context, but do not erase those instructions. The available evidence does not establish that the tool works, that information is misused, or that rewards are delivered.
